newsitem.title: USA: Applied Materials active ahead of earnings.
newsitem.headline: Applied Materials active ahead of earnings.

text.p: Shares of Applied Materials Inc were among the most active stocks on the New York Stock Exchange in early trading on Monday ahead of the release of the company's first fiscal quarter earnings, due tomorrow after the close of trading.
Shares were up 1/8 to 49 in early trading with over a million shares traded.
"We continue to anticipate earnings of $0.45 a share and incoming orders of $725 million to $750 million or perhaps modestly higher," Lehman analyst Edward White said in a research report.

"Semiconductor equipment industry orders are revocering sequentially and Applied Materials is participating in this trend. We thinkthe company will elaborate further on the positive inflectionpoint in its business," he said.
